title: Dev server crashes with unhandled `ECONNRESET` when a WebSocket upgrade request lacks the `vite-hmr`/`vite-ping` subprotocol
author: Znegil

title: Dev server ignores a file save made within 50ms of the previous one (chokidar 3 change throttle)
author: Sheraff
body_preview: ### Describe the bug  When a file is saved twice less than 50ms apart, `server.watcher` emits `change` for the first save only. The second save is never reported, so HMR and SSR keep the stale content until the next unrelated save. title: alwaysStrict / strict leaves nested scopes in sloppy mode (RecursiveSetStrictMode early-exit) → Annex B var can shadow outer bindings
author: fringe4life
body_preview: ## Summary  When TypeScript `alwaysStrict` / `strict` is enabled, esbuild marks **only the module scope** as strict. The later ESM recursive strict walk (`RecursiveSetStrictMode`) **early-exits** because that scope is already non-sloppy, so **nested scopes stay in sloppy mode**.
